name: Chat Bubble Single Rep
description: One Replika chat bubble arriving on the house 240ms ease-out, with the balloon Bezier silhouette. Renders 1:1 (1080x1080) with a transparent background. Text renders in DM Sans, a metric-matched stand-in for the licensed Pangea Text.

params.label: Message
params.description: The message. Wraps at the source's 220px column, so long text becomes a taller multi-line bubble. Wrap the whole message in *asterisks* for a roleplay action, which renders italic with the asterisks removed.

params.label: Sender
params.description: "received" for one of hers - white bubble, dark text, left-aligned, growing from its bottom-left corner. "sent" for one of yours - deep indigo bubble, white text, right-aligned, growing from its bottom-right. Anything starting with "s" reads as sent; anything else as received.

params.label: Duration (s)
params.description: Clip length. The entrance is a fixed 240ms whatever this is set to - the source is explicit that a slower arrival reads as broken - so the remaining time holds the settled bubble. There is no exit animation, because the source has none.
